name: Digital Renaissance
niche: Practical AI and technology for business: new AI tools, automation, how companies are actually using AI, and what it means for people who run or build businesses
audience: Founders, small-business owners, freelancers and ambitious professionals who want to use AI to earn or save money, without hype
tone: Clear, confident, evidence-led and slightly contrarian. No hype, no clickbait the video can't back up.
